question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

She is confident** to win the match.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**of winning the match**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**confident of winning**" is the correct expression to use when referring to someone's confidence in their ability to win.
 
• The highlighted part, "confident to win", is grammatically incorrect and needs to be replaced.
 
• **Option 1 (of to win)** and **Option 4 (on winning match)** are grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 2 (that she wins)** changes the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"She is confident **of winning the match**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "of to win"** is incorrect because "of to" is not a valid construction in English grammar.
 
• **Option 2: "that she wins"** changes the meaning of the sentence, suggesting a possibility rather than confidence.
 
• **Option 4: "on winning match"** is incorrect due to grammatical errors and missing the article "the" before "match".
